answer: When an agent joins the network it must submit a signed beacon to a designated vertex node and stake a 10‑token bond that is locked in the harbor contract for 48 hours; only after the lock expires does the recruiter receive the referral reward. The verifier checks the beacon’s cryptographic link to the recruiter’s identity, and any recruit whose bond is forfeited because the link is reused is automatically blacklisted, preventing the recruiter from wandering free‑recruit cycles.
